correctness.rationale: For odd prime-power q, the trace pairing identifies all additive characters of Sym_3(Fq). Count rank-one forms by projective lines; splitting rank-two restrictions by discriminant gives S1=-1,q²-1,-q²-1,-1 and S2=q²(q-1),q³-2q²,q³,-q² for rank-1,rank-2 split,rank-2 nonsplit,rank-3 dual frequencies. The nonconstant eigenvalues are all negative except the strictly increasing rank-three one -1+q²(3^t-2^t), whose unique root in (0,1) is beta. Strictness and endpoint real nullity follow by real Fourier diagonalization and Schoenberg centering; rank-three frequency multiplicity q²(q-1)(q³-1) yields endpoint dimension (q³-1)(q²+1). Independent q=3 finite Fourier transform checks for representative rank sectors gave (-1,18), (8,9),(-10,27),(-1,-9), agreeing with the formulas; q² beta ->1/log(3/2). Fields characteristic two are excluded.
